# ShopDrop

## Bicycle Blue Book: The safe and secure way to buy a bike locally

Introducing ShopDrop – the hassle-free way to buy bikes locally. Sellers drop their bikes at one of
our participating local bike shops, where they're securely stored until you pick them up. No
shipping. No parking lot meetups. Just safe, convenient pickup at a trusted location.

Look for the ShopDrop icon on product pages to find bikes available for in-store pickup. Pay online,
then collect your bike at your chosen Trek store during regular hours.

## Local Buying, done right.

## The Blue Book Promise: Your safety net for every purchase

We stand behind every marketplace transaction. Whether you're buying or selling, our protection
program covers damage in transit, ensures bikes match their descriptions, and guarantees all
critical components arrive as promised.

## Best Bikepacking Bikes for Off-Road Adventures

Discover the key features that define the best bikepacking bikes, from ample tire clearance to
reliable components, ensuring your gear stays secure while tackling rugged terrains. Whether you're
seeking a rugged mountain bike or a versatile gravel rig, we explore top models designed to enhance
your adventure, no matter the distance or landscape.

[Read more][75]

# Compare and Buy Bikes & E-Bikes online

BikeExchange USA is an online marketplace for bikes, e-bikes and cycling gear, where offers from
independent bike dealers are centrally comparable. Shoppers can discover models from leading brands,
compare prices, and check availability across the United States. The platform combines the
convenience of online shopping with the expertise of local bike shops. This makes it easier to find
the right bike at the right price.

# Compare and Buy Bikes & E-Bikes online

BikeExchange USA is an online marketplace for bikes, e-bikes and cycling gear, where offers from
independent bike dealers are centrally comparable. Shoppers can discover models from leading brands,
compare prices, and check availability across the United States. The platform combines the
convenience of online shopping with the expertise of local bike shops. This makes it easier to find
the right bike at the right price.

# Evans Cycles - Online Bike Shop & Stores Nationwide

Enjoy flying up the hills? Start with our range of [road bikes][107]. Or if it's all about tracks
and trails, head to our [mountain bikes][108] for a mix of hardtail and full suspension machines.
We've even got a full range of [hybrid bikes][109] (perfect for commuting), which includes several
[folding bikes][110] - ideal if you're taking the train or you're short on storage space. Still not
sure which bike is for you? Pop into one of our [UK bike stores][111] where our friendly staff will
help, or have a read of our super handy [buying guides][112]

We also stock all the [clothing][113] and [accessories][114] you'll ever need, as well as a wide
range of [parts and components][115] to keep your bike in top-top condition. Plus, shopping with us
gives you lots of great benefits like our Click & Collect. Enjoy the ride.

## **Premium Road Bike Rental Delivered To Your Door**

At BikeRental.cc our mission is to get your rolling with a smile on your face, riding premium bikes
and providing exceptional service that gives you best riding experience.

We only stock top spec carbon road bikes with carbon wheels and electronic shifting to deliver the
ultimate road bike rental experience. So you can ride a road bike thats the same spec of bike you
may have at home or perhaps an opportunity to experience what its like to ride a top end light
weight road bike.

Enjoy our white glove service with delivery of your hired road bike to your door whether that be at
your hotel concierge, AirBNB or office.

Beyond road bike rental we offer a range of services including guided group rides, corporate team
building virtual bike activations, spinathon charity fundraisers, brand activations and bike
mechanic activations.

## **Simply The Best Road Bikes Available For Hire**

### Check out our premium road bike range available for hire. Full spec without the price tag.

### Chapter2 is our top of the range performance road bike designed in NZ. We are excited to launch
### Winspace performance road bikes and The Carbon Project Triathlon bike for hire in cities across
### Australia.


## **Chapter2 Performance Road & Gravel Bikes**

Rent a Chapter2 road or gravel bikes with carbon wheels and electronic shifting. A New Zealand brand
thats built a reputation for top end performance road and gravel bikes that are a dream to ride.


## **Winspace Performance Road Bikes **

Experience Winspace's fastest aero road bikes available for rent with the latest light weight
Winspace Carbon wheelsets. The leading Chinese brand taking the world by storm with innovative
performance road bikes.


## **The Carbon Project Triathlon Bike**

Rent the The Carbon Project triathlon bike for your next triathlon event with full carbon frame,
aero carbon wheels, electronic shifting and adjustable aero bars.

## **Bike Rental Locations**

### Rent a performance road bike in cities around Australia and we have just launched Singapore as
### we begin our global expansion.

Discover Sydney

## **Bike Rental Sydney**

Rent a high-performance carbon road or gravel bike and experience iconic Sydney sights, from the
Sydney Opera House to the scenic Bondi Beach and Blue Mountains. BikeRental.cc offers top spec road
bikes, including Chapter2, Bianchi and Winspace, delivered directly to your hotel with route advice,
accessories, and optional guided rides for an unforgettable cycling adventure.

[ Rent A Bike in Sydney ][241]

Explore Melbourne

## **Bike Rental Melbourne**

Melbourne is set up for cycling with its many bike paths, along the river and the bay. As well as
providing longer routes and hill climbs for more serious cyclists.

Check out our range of premium Chapter2 and Winspace road bikes with carbon frames, wheels and
electronic shifting for the ultimate road bike rental experience.

## Ride Your Love Story™

[WATCH ][38]

BlackHeart was built on a belief.

A belief that riding is about so much more than just, well, riding. It’s about the connection to the
environment around you, to the present, to yourself. It’s about the bike becoming an extension of
your body, and the road ahead becoming a map for who you aspire to be.

Ultimately, it’s the belief that you’re a better version of you after each ride. And as the miles
melt by, and the wind kisses your face, you’re adding new chapters to the great, winding novel that
is your life. 

This is your story…you ride it.

## Ride Your Love Story™

[WATCH ][38]

BlackHeart was built on a belief.

A belief that riding is about so much more than just, well, riding. It’s about the connection to the
environment around you, to the present, to yourself. It’s about the bike becoming an extension of
your body, and the road ahead becoming a map for who you aspire to be.

Ultimately, it’s the belief that you’re a better version of you after each ride. And as the miles
melt by, and the wind kisses your face, you’re adding new chapters to the great, winding novel that
is your life. 

This is your story…you ride it.

# Welcome to Cara Trade

Cara Trade Ireland’s premier cycling distributor, supplying premium bikes, components and
accessories to independent bike shops throughout the country. Rather than selling directly to
consumers, Cara Trade works through a nationwide dealer network so customers can receive expert
in-store advice, professional bike fitting, assembly, servicing, and after-sales support. Caratrade
is an Irish owned company.

Our portfolio spans several respected international cycling brands across road, gravel, mountain,
commuter, and lifestyle cycling categories.

**Featured Brands:**

**LOOK** - French manufacturer best known for high-performance road bikes, carbon frame technology,
and pioneering clipless pedal systems. LOOK bikes are widely associated with competitive road
cycling and triathlon.

** Ridley** - Belgian performance cycling brand with a strong reputation in cyclocross, aero road
bikes, gravel bikes, and endurance racing platforms.

** Nukeproof** - Popular among mountain bikers for aggressive trail, enduro, and downhill bikes
designed for demanding terrain and bike-park riding.

** Eddy Merckx** - Named after legendary Belgian cyclist Eddy Merckx, this brand focuses on premium
road and endurance bicycles that combine racing heritage with comfort and modern geometry.

** REID** - Offers accessible commuter, hybrid, electric, and recreational bicycles aimed at
everyday riders and urban mobility.

** Zéfal** - Long-established French accessories company producing pumps, hydration products,
mudguards, bike maintenance tools, and storage solutions.
